tools.name: accounts_solve-checkpoint
tools.description: Allows you to provide a code which will solve a checkpoint encountered during a native authentication. A checkpoint is a security step added by a provider which needs to be solved to complete the authentication. Checkpoints that require a code are 2FA (two-factor authentication) and OTP (one-time password). Depending on the way you have configured the account you are trying to authenticate, you can get your code from various ways such as a mail, a SMS or from a two-factor authentication app. Required: account_id, code, provider. Returns the new AccountsSolveCheckpointResponse.

params.name: account_id
params.description: A unique identifier.

params.name: code
params.description: The code to solve the checkpoint. If the code is a phone number, it should be preceded by the international dialling code in brackets (e.g. (+33)0612345678 for France). If you need to switch to a different type of checkpoint, enter TRY_ANOTHER_WAY here (e.g. from In app validation to 2FA).

params.name: chat_id
params.description: The id of the chat to be patched

params.name: action
params.description: The action to perform on the chat: - `setReadStatus`: (WhatsApp & LinkedIn only) Set the read status of the chat. - `setMuteStatus`: (WhatsApp & LinkedIn only) Set the mute status of the chat. - `setArchiveStatus`: (WhatsApp only) Set the archive status of the chat. - `setPinnedStatus`: (WhatsApp only) Set the pinned status of the chat. - `addParticipant`: (WhatsApp & Telegram only) Add a participant to the group chat. The account owner must have the Add other members permission in the group. Provide the provider ID as value, for example 334455667788@s.whatsapp.net for WhatsApp, or a Telegram user ID, username, or phone number for Telegram. - `removeParticipant`: (WhatsApp & Telegram only) Remove a participant from the group chat. Provide the provider ID as value, for example 334455667788@s.whatsapp.net for WhatsApp, or a Telegram user ID, username, or phone number for Telegram. - `setLabel`: (WhatsApp only) Add a label to the chat. If the label does not exist, it will be created and then assigned. - `getInviteLink`: (WhatsApp & Telegram only) Generate or retrieve the full group invite link. The account owner must have the required invite permissions in the group.

params.name: value
params.description: Required for every action except `getInviteLink`. Use a boolean for status actions and a string for participant or label actions.

novel_features.name: Rate-budget ledger
novel_features.description: See how many LinkedIn invitations you have left today and this week, counted from your synced invitation history.

novel_features.name: Offline cross-provider search
novel_features.description: Full-text search every message, email, attendee, and relation across all connected providers at once, offline.

novel_features.name: Contact 360
novel_features.description: Everything the local mirror knows about one person: connection state, invitation history, and every conversation with per-direction message counts.

novel_features.name: Unified unread inbox
novel_features.description: One table of everything unread across LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, and email.

novel_features.name: Silence detection
novel_features.description: Find conversations where you sent the last message and got no reply for N days.

novel_features.name: Accepted but not messaged
novel_features.description: New LinkedIn connections since your last sync that you have not messaged yet.

novel_features.name: Invitation funnel
novel_features.description: Sent, accepted, and replied counts with conversion rates over a time window.

novel_features.name: Cross-provider digest
novel_features.description: What changed across every connected provider since the last sync.

novel_features.name: Resolved thread view
novel_features.description: Read one conversation end to end with attendee IDs resolved to real names.

novel_features.name: Post engagement crossmatch
novel_features.description: Who reacted to or commented on your posts, flagged by whether they are already a connection.
